question: What is ITCSS and how does it apply to SCSS?
shortAnswer: Inverted Triangle CSS layers: settings → tools → generic → elements → objects → components → utilities.
detailedAnswer: Controls specificity growth and cascade. Map layers to partial folders. Utilities win when needed.

question: BEM with SCSS — recommended nesting style?
shortAnswer: Nest only &__element and &--modifier under the block; avoid tagging elements by tag name.
detailedAnswer: Keeps specificity low and intent clear. Don't nest .block .other-block deeply.

question: How do you structure theming for white-label products?
shortAnswer: Primitive tokens + semantic aliases per brand; swap brand maps or CSS variable layers at runtime/build.
detailedAnswer: Avoid forking component SCSS per brand. Override tokens, not components.

question: Utility-first vs component SCSS — coexistence rules?
shortAnswer: Utilities for layout spacing; components for recurring UI; forbid one-off utilities that duplicate components.
detailedAnswer: Document decision tree. Lint for banned patterns if needed.

question: Where should global resets live?
shortAnswer: Once in base/generic layer of the entrypoint — never re-included by components.
detailedAnswer: Normalize/reset conflicts are painful. Own a single reset strategy.

question: Scenario: marketing site and app shell share SCSS kit but diverge visually.
shortAnswer: Shared primitives; separate semantic themes; optional component subsets per surface.
detailedAnswer: Don't force identical components if UX differs — share tokens/tools first.

question: How does specificity budgeting work in SCSS architecture?
shortAnswer: Prefer single-class components, limit nesting, ban IDs in styles, and review !important usage.
detailedAnswer: Stylelint plugins help. High specificity is a leading indicator of architecture debt.

question: Design system package versioning for SCSS?
shortAnswer: Semver on token/mixin public API; changelogs; codemods for renames; peer dependency on Sass.
detailedAnswer: Breaking token renames break apps — treat seriously. Provide migration guides.

question: CSS Modules + SCSS architecture pitfalls?
shortAnswer: Composing globals accidentally, duplicating tokens, and unclear ownership of shared partials.
detailedAnswer: Central tokens module; local styles for structure. Agree on :global usage policy.

question: When to prefer plain CSS over SCSS in modern apps?
shortAnswer: If you only need variables/nesting now native, and toolchain cost exceeds benefits.
detailedAnswer: SCSS still wins for maps/mixins/design-system packages. Choose deliberately.

question: Documentation standards for SCSS architecture?
shortAnswer: Architecture decision records, folder README, public API of mixins/tokens, and examples in Storybook.
detailedAnswer: Undocumented partials become landfill. Link visual examples.

question: Lead: consolidate three divergent SCSS stacks post-merger.
shortAnswer: Inventory tokens/components, pick target architecture, bridge themes, migrate high-traffic UI first.
detailedAnswer: Freeze new divergence. Measure CSS weight and visual regressions.

question: How do critical CSS and SCSS architecture interact?
shortAnswer: Componentize so critical path CSS can be extracted; avoid huge shared bundles of unused components.
detailedAnswer: Purge/content detection and modular imports matter. Architecture enables performance.

question: Ownership model: who approves new global tokens?
shortAnswer: Design + eng guild; RFC for semantic tokens; automated publish; no ad-hoc hex in apps.
detailedAnswer: Prevents token sprawl. Apps consume, don't invent primitives.
